import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(["python", "-c", 
    "import warnings; warnings.simplefilter('error'); import arrow; a = arrow.utcnow(); print(a.tzinfo, a.utcoffset())"], 
    capture_output=True, text=True)
print("stdout:", result.stdout)
print("stderr:", result.stderr)
